- When sentiment is positive (≥ 0.23) in recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast slightly.
- When sentiment is negative (≤ -0.16), model often underestimates; adjust upward, especially if recent price is rising.
- Model frequently overshoots after sharp price spikes (e.g., +10%+ in 3-5 days); cap forecast at +5% above recent peak.
- Mean reversion bias: if 3-5 consecutive days show downward trend, model often fails to correct; add 0.5–1.0% upward bias to counteract.
- For 30-day horizon, model tends to lag by 1–3 days in response to sentiment shifts; align forecast with sentiment peak 1–2 days ahead.
- If sentiment history shows alternating +/– cycles, model overfits to recent sentiment; dampen forecast by 0.3–0.7% if sentiment is volatile.
